dct_description_sm: The aim of this research project is to develop an in-situ method to measure hydrological processes in frozen soils through the characterization of coaxial impedance dielectric reflectometry probe response to soil freeze-thaw events. This data set is collected for the project titled Transformative sensor Technologies and Smart Watershed (TTWS), which is a Pillar 3 project under the Global Water Futures Program funded by Canada First Research Excellence Fund.
dct_title_s: Soil Dielectric, Temperature, and Heat Capacity Data from Ontario Agricultural Soils Undergoing Phase Transitions in a Laboratory Setting
